role: Ghatotkacha's son, Bhima's grandson; boasted he could end the war in one muhurta; his head watched the war; worshipped as Khatu Shyam
look: Young warrior, about 18-20; warm brown skin (#9A6440); thick curly black hair in a high topknot with a gold band; vertical saffron-and-red tilak; gold ear studs; yellow sash; deep-blue dhoti with a front pleat; leather forearm guards; longbow; quiver with exactly three blue-fletched arrows.
sourceNotes: Named for his hair 'like that of a Barbara' (Skanda Purana, Kaumarika Khanda 60.62-68). Three arrows are from the Khatu folk tradition. Everything else is a design choice. Worshipped today: keep him noble and gentle.
notes: Drawn by Claude as hand-written SVG for X001 (no external generator). Head at translate(500 330). The sky-head prop (props/barbarika-head-sky.svg) reuses this head in translucent gold with a small crown.
